if [ $SS_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "SS s456 training failed, skipping eval, jumping to split-softmax"

# D048 Remaining Queue: SS s456 train+eval → Split-softmax eval
# Runs after d048_final_ar_eval.sh completes
set +e

cd /root/turn_residual_gating
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate base

PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python3.12
CONV_PATH=data/ultrachat_eval_heldout.json

echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') === [1/4] SS s456 Training ==="
bash scripts/d048_ss_s456.sh
SS_EXIT=$?
echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') SS s456 training exit code: $SS_EXIT"

if [ $SS_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "SS s456 training failed, skipping eval, jumping to split-softmax"
else
    # Find best epoch
    CKPT_DIR=runs/d048_ss_s456
    BEST_EPOCH=""
    for ep in 2 1 0; do
        ep_dir="${CKPT_DIR}/epoch_${ep}"
        if [ -d "$ep_dir/lora" ] && [ -f "$ep_dir/gate_params.pt" ]; then
            BEST_EPOCH="$ep_dir"
            break
        fi
    done
    if [ -z "$BEST_EPOCH" ]; then
        echo "WARNING: No complete checkpoint found in $CKPT_DIR"
    else
        echo "SS s456 checkpoint: $BEST_EPOCH"

        echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') === [2/4] SS s456 TF Eval ==="
        mkdir -p results/d048_ss_s456

        $PYTHON src/eval_phase2_gar.py \
          --gate-type threadgate \
          --checkpoint-dir "$BEST_EPOCH" \
          --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
          --output-dir results/d048_ss_s456/tf_ours \
          --gar-variant ours \
          --gate-profile || echo "TF eval (ours) failed with $?"

        $PYTHON src/eval_phase2_gar.py \
          --gate-type threadgate \
          --checkpoint-dir "$BEST_EPOCH" \
          --conversations-path "$CONV_PATH" \
          --output-dir results/d048_ss_s456/tf_dongre \
          --gar-variant dongre \
          --gate-profile || echo "TF eval (dongre) failed with $?"

        echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') === [3/4] SS s456 AR N=50 Eval ==="
        $PYTHON src/eval_attention_steering.py \
          --checkpoint "$BEST_EPOCH" \
          --gate-type threadgate \
          --mode gen \
          --data-file data/eval_200/eval_200.json \
          --max-convs 50 \
          --beta 0 3 5 \
          --gar-variant ours \
          --output-dir results/d048_ss_s456 \
          --output-name ss_s456_ar_n50 || echo "AR eval failed with $?"
    fi
fi

echo "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') === [4/4] Split-Softmax Eval ==="
bash scripts/d048_split_softmax_eval.sh || echo "Split-softmax eval failed with $?"


echo "=========================================="
echo "[STEP] SS s123 Training"
echo "=========================================="
cd /root/turn_residual_gating
source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
python src/train_phase2_v8b.py \
    --model Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct \
    --data-file data/ultrachat_multi_turn_train_2k.json \
    --output-dir runs/d048_ss_s123 \
    --epochs 3 \
    --batch-size 2 \
    --gradient-accumulation-steps 4 \
    --lr 2e-5 \
    --warmup-ratio 0.03 \
    --seed 123 \
    --gate-type thread \
    --gar-lambda 0.1 \
    --ss-max-ratio 0.3 \
    --gpu 0 \
    2>&1 | tee runs/d048_ss_s123_train.log
echo "SS s123 training exit code: $?"

echo "=========================================="
echo "[STEP] SS s123 Eval (TF + AR N=50)"
echo "=========================================="
cd /root/turn_residual_gating

# TF eval
python src/eval_attention_steering.py \

    --gate-type thread \
    --mode tf \
    --data-file data/eval_200/eval_200.json \
    --output-dir results/d048_final_ar \
    --output-prefix ss_s123 \
    --gpu 0 \
    2>&1 | tee runs/d048_ss_s123_tf_eval.log

# AR N=50 eval
